body:
Asha: quick question for the surface team: should SDKs offer a built-in prefetch-on-iterate mode for paginated endpoints? saw some perf wins in benching but worried about retry semantics.
Jon: short answer: maybe. need clear retry isolation and opt-in defaults.
Asha: agreed. sketch of behaviour: iterator can optionally spawn lightweight prefetch tasks for next N pages. prefetch results are buffered and returned when consumer advances.
Li: language differences: TS async iterators = easy; py sync iterator needs thread/shim or background thread; go needs goroutine + channel. ergonomics will differ.
Sam: perf data: default no prefetch p99=420ms, with window=1 p99=300ms, token usage +6-9% depending on payload. Hosted customers probably fine, Dedicated customers may care.
Jon: surface idea: expose PrefetchPolicy on iterator creation, default off. policy fields: window, max_inflight, retry_policy (isolated | strict), waste_threshold.
Asha: what does retry_policy do exactly?
Jon: isolated => prefetch failures don't block foreground; SDK retries prefetch independently with backoff; strict => treat prefetch failure as iterator error.
Li: i prefer isolated default across SDKs. less surprising. allow strict for users who want correctness guarantees.
Sam: also need 429/ratelimit handling: if prefetch gets 429, backoff exponentially and lower inflight. for 5xx try a small quick retry then stop; metric that counts prefetch_waste events.
Asha: good. api sketches:
TS: const it = client.listItems({pageSize:200}).withPrefetch({window:1, maxInflight:2, retryPolicy:'isolated'})
Python: for page in client.list_items(page_size=200, prefetch=Prefetch(window=1, max_inflight=2, retry_policy='isolated')):
    ...
Go: it := client.ListItems(ctx, opts.WithPrefetch(Prefetch{Window:1, MaxInflight:2, RetryPolicy: PrefetchIsolated}))

Li: tests we'll need: mid-iteration cancel (ensure prefetched items are either cleaned up or attributed), prefetch 5xx/429 behaviour, and memory bounds when window large.
Jon: telemetry: add iterator-level counters: prefetch_attempts, prefetch_success, prefetch_failures, prefetch_waste_count, prefetch_latency_ms histogram. Also tag by model/route and customer.
Sam: console: show customers who enabled prefetch and estimated token delta and p99 improvement. important for Dedicated billing conversations.
Asha: server-side support: optional idempotency token for prefetched pages so server can dedupe when same page fetch happens from foreground later. mark as advanced opt requiring server changes.
Li: compatibility: make prefetch opt-in and feature-flagged in SDKs for first roll. we can enable hosted default later if telemetry looks good.
Jon: implementation note for TS: make prefetch buffer a simple ring; expose a cancellation hook so when consumer cancels iterator we cancel in-flight prefetch requests.
Sam: retry state machine sketch: states = idle, inflight, backing_off; transitions on success, 429 (backoff with jitter), 5xx (quick retry then fail), cancel => cancel all. config knobs: initial_backoff_ms, max_backoff_ms, max_retries.
Asha: action items: 1) Jon + Li implement API sketches and small examples (TS + py) 2) Sam implement retry state machine + metrics backend hooks 3) Asha write docs draft and hosted vs Dedicated recommendation 4) Add integration test matrix and feature flag gating.
triage-bot: design-review: scheduled 2026-03-22 09:30 PT (link: https://meet.example/rtc/def456)
Jon: i'll push a short PR with TS iterator surface and unit tests for cancel case.
Li: i'll prototype python shim to keep for-loop ergonomics without forcing async. will post by EOD.
Sam: i'll add metrics names and a prometheus mapping doc.
Asha: thanks all. keeping opt-in for now. :+1:
